p: light is come: The time of your prosperity and happiness: while speaking of Babylon, he commanded her to go down, Isa 47:1.
earth: Signifying, that all men are in darkness till God gives them the light of his Spirit, and that this light shines to no one, but to those that are in his Church.
thy light: Meaning, that Judea would be as the morning star, and that the Gentiles would receive light from her.
they gather themselves together: An infinite number from all countries as in Isa 49:18.
and be enlarged: For joy, as the heart is drawn in for sorrow.

multitude of camels shall cover thee: Meaning, that everyone will honour the Lord with that with which he is able: Signifying that it is no true serving of God unless we offer ourselves to serve his glory, and all that we have.
Kedar shall be gathered together to: That is the Arabians, that have great abundance of cattle.
altar: Because the altar was a figure of Christ, He 13:10, he shows that nothing can be acceptable to him, which is not offered to him by this altar, who was both the offering and the altar itself.
that fly as a cloud: Showing what great number will come to the Church, and with what great diligence and zeal.
of Tarshish first: The Gentiles that are now enemies, will become friends and set forth the Church.
kings shall minister to thee: Meaning Cyrus and his successors, but chiefly this is accomplished in them that serve Christ, being converted by his gospel.
kingdom that will not serve thee: He shows that God has given all power and authority here in earth for the use of his Church, and that they who will not serve and profit the same will be destroyed.
glory of Lebanon shall come to: There is nothing so excellent which will not serve the needs of the Church.
feet glorious: Signifying that God's majesty is not included in the temple, which is but the place for his feet, that we may learn to rise to the heavens.
down at the soles of thy: To worship their head Christ, by obeying his doctrine.
breast of kings: Both high and low will be ready to help and comfort you.
peace: Your governors will love you, and seek your wealth and prosperity.
call thy walls Salvation: Meaning not an earthly happiness, but spiritual, which is fulfilled in Christ's kingdom.
moon give light to thee: Signifying that all worldly means will cease, and that Christ will be all in all, as in Re 21:23,22:5.
branch of my planting: The children of the Church.
thousand: Meaning, that the Church would be miraculously multiplied.
